name: rate_limited_returns_code_1002
description: Calling a tool whose max_concurrent permits are exhausted returns Response::Error { code: 1002, retryable: true }. Requires the target server to expose a permanently-saturated tool — the atd reference server does this via `ref:conformance.saturate_op` (registered with max_concurrent=1 when `--enable-conformance-tool` is passed; its sole permit is leaked at server startup so any client call finds the semaphore empty). Third-party servers that want to validate this case must expose a tool with id `ref:conformance.saturate_op` declaring max_concurrent=1, and arrange for that permit to be permanently held (e.g., on startup) so single-shot client calls always hit the rate-limit path.
